game.title: Diablo IV
game.blurb: Online action RPG from Blizzard Entertainment (RAWG lists Activision Blizzard), released 2023-06-06. RAWG average playtime: 13 hours (well under a full run). Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Diablo IV" or "Diablo 4". diablo.fandom.com answers the API, with about 216 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Cedar" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2344520. None of the 45 Steam achievements are hidden. Requires an online connection; the PvP achievement is grouped with endgame rather than given its own chapter. Charm Sets, Transfigured gear and War Plans look like newer features; which update they came from was not checked. Wildland Warrior (Dregs, Lacuni, Hollows) may belong with Vessel of Hatred but sits in the world chapter.
